scope: Three saved CORE successes, original/cheap/size/support; no improvement.
result: All arithmetic proof counts unchanged. Size/support outputs byte-identical to cheap; no repeats or promotion justified.
optimizer_diagnostic: 42 bounded LassoRanker calls print unsat then model unavailable and exit nonzero; adapter rejects and retains incumbent. Not checker failures or global minimality evidence.

command:
set -uo pipefail
save=()
if [[ -n $7 ]]; then save=(--save "$7"); fi
prlimit --as=3221225472 --fsize=268435456 -- \
  "$1" "$2" "$3" - --raw --cadical "$4" "${save[@]}" \
  2> "$6/producer.err" |
prlimit --as=3221225472 --fsize=268435456 -- \
  "$5" "$2" - > "$6/kernel.out" 2> "$6/kernel.err"
statuses=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
printf '%s %s\n' "${statuses[0]}" "${statuses[1]}" > "$6/exit-status.txt"
if (( statuses[0] != 0 || statuses[1] != 0 )); then exit 1; fi
grep -Fxq 'challenge proven' "$6/kernel.out"
! grep -Fxq 'Inconsistency proven!' "$6/kernel.out"
